name: Machine Learning in Textile and Fibre Engineering
description: Evolution of AI, ML and soft computing; supervised, unsupervised and reinforcement learning; artificial neural networks (ANN), ANN training algorithms, convolutional neural network (CNN), decision tree-based models, random forest, XG boost; fuzzy sets and fuzzy logic, fuzzy inference system, fuzzy decision making; intelligent optimisation, evolutionary algorithms, genetic algorithms, particle swarm optimization, simulated annealing; hybrid AI-ML systems, adaptive network based fuzzy inference system (ANFIS); generative AI and AI agents in textiles; applications of various AI and ML techniques in textile and fibre engineering problems.
